summary: Petition under sub-section (4) of Section 28 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 10 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Fees & Charges of Regional Load Despatch Centre and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 for determination of fees and charges of NLDC and RLDCs for the control period 2024-29. Katwaria Sarai, New Delhi - 110016 . Petitioner - _(a) Kindly grant the interim relief by allowing the RLDCs to bill 85% of annual LDC Charges (including the NLDC portion) claimed in the Petition No. 853/MP/2025 from 1_ _st_ _April 2024 onwards, till the issuance of final orders in the matter;_ - _(b) Pass such other order as the Hon’ble Commission deems fit and appropriate in this case and in the interest of justice;_ - b) This increase in actual expenditure incurred with respect to the billed revenue leads to severe cash flow issues and increases the unbilled revenue. Further, it is pertinent to mention that the revised true-up Petitions for the Control Period 2019-24 (as per Commission’s order dated 27.03.2026) were filed before the Commission in May 2026, and a significant amount is pending for billing, subject to approval from the Commission after truing up of Fees and Charges for Control Period 2019-24. - c) The Summary of the Annual LDC Charges (ALC) claimed in the Petition No. 853/MP/2025 is mentioned below: - e) The comparison of the ALC claimed in the Petition No. 853/MP/2025 and the billed ALC during FYs 2024-25 and 2025-26 is tabulated below: - h) In view of the above facts and circumstances, it is respectfully prayed that the Commission may be pleased to grant the interim relief by allowing the RLDCs to bill 85% of annual LDC Charges (including the apportioned NLDC Charges) claimed in the Petition No. 853/MP/2025 from 1 st April 2024 onwards, till the issuance of final orders in the matter. _At the outset, the representative of the Petitioner, NLDC, submitted that NLDC has filed an IA seeking interim relief in respect of Fees and Charges claimed by NLDC & RLDCs in the_ _Petition No. 853/MP/2025 for the control period 2024-29. As per Regulation 10 (4) of the Commission’s (Fees & Charges of Regional Load Despatch Centre and other related matters) Regulations 2024, RLDCs are raising monthly bills on the basis of Annual LDC Charges (ALC) approved by the Commission for FY 2023-24 w.e.f. 1.4.2024 onwards. She further submitted that the actual expenses have increased in comparison with those of FY 2023-24 and thus, the RLDCs may be allowed to provisionally bill 85% of annual LDC Charges (including the apportioned NLDC Charges) claimed in the Petition No. 853/MP/2025 from 1.4.2024 onwards, till the issuance of final orders in the matter._ _3. Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission directed the Respondents to file their respective replies on the IA within a week. Subject to this, the Commission reserved the IA No.118/2026 for order for interim relief._ 6. Petitioner has submitted that Petition No. 853/MP/2025 for approval of the Fee and Charges for 2024-29 is under approval before the Commission, and further, the Petitions filed by different RLDCs for truing up of the Fee and Charges for the control Period 2019-24 are also under approval before the Commission. Petitioner has submitted that the actual expenditure incurred with respect to the billed revenue (as per Regulation 10(4) of the RLDC Fee and Charges Regulations, 2024) leads to severe cash flow issues and increases the unbilled revenue. Further, because the truing up of the fee and charges for 2014-1 is pending approval, a significant amount is pending for billing. Accordingly, the Petitioner has prayed for interim relief by allowing the RLDCs to bill 85% of annual LDC charges (including the apportioned NLDC charges) as claimed in Petition No. 853/MP/2025 from 1.4.2024 onwards, till the issuance of the final Order in Petition No. 853/MP/2025. 7. We have considered the submission of the Petitioner. We also note that none of the Respondents has filed its reply on the instant IA. _“(4) During the pendency of the petition, the RLDCs shall continue to bill the users on the basis of fees and charges approved by the Commission during the previous control period and applicable as on 31.3.2024, for the period starting from 1.4.2024 till approval of the Fees and Charges by the Commission, in accordance with these Regulations.”_ As per the above, during the pendency of the Petition, the RLDCs shall continue to bill the users on the basis of fees and charges approved by the Commission during the previous control period, as applicable as on 31.32024, for the period starting from 1.4.2024 till approval of the Fees and Charges by the Commission. 9. We note that the Petitioner has highlighted a difference in the RLDC Fee & Charges claimed for 2024-29 vis-à-vis revenue billed as per Regulation 10(4), causing severe cash flow issues and increasing the unbilled revenue. In this regard, we have perused the amount billed as per Regulation 10(4) of the RLDC Fee and Charges Regulation vs the Fee and Charges claimed by the RLDCs for the control period 2024-29 in Petition No. 853/MP/2025, as under: 13. The IA No. 118/2026 in Petition No. 853/MP/2025 is disposed of in terms of the above.
title: Petition under sub-section (4) of Section 28 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 10 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Fees & Charges of Regional Load Despatch Centre and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 for determination of fees and charges of NLDC and RLDCs for the control period 2024-29.
